business_summary: Dai Nippon Printing Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the printing and information business. The company operates through smart Communication, Life & Healthcare, and Electronics segments. It offers Books, magazines, textbooks, e-books, digital marketing support, BPR consulting and BPO services, contact center, IPS, smart cards, payment-related services, card-related equipment, authentication and security services and related product; IC tags, holograms, business forms, catalogs, leaflets, brochures, calendars, point-of-purchase materials, digital signage, as well as engages in planning, development, production, construction, operations of events, stores, products, contents, virtual space, dye-sublimation thermal transfer media, and thermal resin-type transfer printing media. The company also provides ID photo, portrait photograph and ID solutions, entertainment and amusement imaging solutions, e-book, library management, and other services; lithium-ion battery pouches, photovoltaic module components, transparent barrier film products, industrial high-performance materials, and various types of packaging materials; cups, plastic bottles, laminated tubes, molded plastic containers, aseptic filling systems, interior and exterior materials; and molded parts. In addition, it offers optical films for displays, metal masks for organic displays, large photomasks for liquid crystal displays, electric shades, photomasks for semiconductor products, lead frames for small semiconductor packages, LSI design, hard disk drive suspensions, camera module components for smartphones, and other products. The company was founded in 1876 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
